description: Source code implementing CFIFrameInfo class and related parsing logic for call frame information in breakpad.

classes.name: CFIFrameInfo
classes.description: Represents call frame information, including rules for CFA and return address, and provides serialization.

classes.name: CFIRuleParser
classes.description: Parses rule sets for call frame information and reports rules to handler.

classes.name: CFIFrameInfoParseHandler
classes.description: Handles parsed rules and updates CFIFrameInfo accordingly.

methods.name: FindCallerRegs
methods.description: Computes caller register values based on current register states and rules.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the CFI frame info rules into a string.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a rule set string into individual rules.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Reports parsed rules to the handler.

methods.name: CFARule
methods.description: Sets the CFA rule in the frame info.

methods.name: RARule
methods.description: Sets the return address rule in the frame info.

methods.name: RegisterRule
methods.description: Sets a register rule in the frame info.
